newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: ING changes Slovak VUB share rating to sell.
newsitem.headline: ING changes Slovak VUB share rating to sell.

text.p: Poor 1996 results and an uncertain future for Slovak bank VUB a.s. have changed ING Barings' recommendation on its shares to a sell from a previous hold, an ING investor report said.
The ING report gave no price for its recommendation. VUB closed down 15 crowns at 1,835 on the Bratislava Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
"The bank has not made adequate provisions for its substantial non performing loan portfolio," the report said.
"...there is a high level of uncertainty about the bank's future management direction considering it will be of the main banks privatised (if bank privatisation proceeds)," it added.
VUB posted a net loss of 752 million crowns for the January-June 1996 period, compared to a 1.35 billion crown net profit over the same period last year.
The report also cited falling margins and the bank's low capital adequacy, currently standing at 4.8 percent, as reasons for the recommendation change.

Over the summer, VUB shares hovered well above the 2,000 crown level, hitting a high of 2,300 crowns, but brokers said the price had been pushed up artificially without fundamentals to back up the rise.
